755030201.text: Hehe, fancy bumping into the two of you again, and at none other than the finest scenic spot that the People of the Springs has to offer! Not only that, this place is universally recognized as one of the most stunning sights in the whole of southern Natlan.

755030202.text: The azure blue of the vast expanses of water, the lush green of the mountain vegetation, intertwined with the intense fiery hues of the phlogiston... Simply breathtaking, and a masterclass intro to color contrast too.

755030203.text: Dopey Dazzler! Pretty fast on your feet, huh?

755030204.text: No use lecturing us on color theory yet though — we still won't get it...

755030207.text: Well, core members of the Graffiti Alliance technically make it their mission to travel to every corner of Natlan, familiarizing themselves with the culture and customs of all the different tribes.

755030208.text: A while back now, the People of the Springs hired us to spray-paint their watersports gear. It was a very large order, so I had to stay here for quite some time.

755030209.text: They paid us very well, so to return the favor, I decided it was only fair if I made the design I sprayed onto each and every one of their watersports products totally unique.

755030210.text: In the end, after two months of slogging away, I'd only finished less than five percent of the total... My hands were so sore they felt like they were about to fall off, and my brain had totally crashed...

755030211.text: And to make matters worse, new products were constantly being churned out. If things kept going the way they were, I'd never have been able to finish the job...

755030212.text: A unique design, for every, single, individual, watersports product...!?

755030213.text: But... there are watersports products everywhere at the People of the Springs — you couldn't even count them if you tried. That goal was totally crazy!
